rule: For every UTC day D from 1 August to 31 October of 2015, 2019 and 2023, separately for Kalimantan [108.5, -4.5, 119.5, 4.5] and Sumatra [95, -6, 106.5, 6] (west, south, east, north), using NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP standard-processing detections from the yearly Indonesia country files with type == 0 (presumed vegetation fire): (1) group the detections of day D on a 0.06 degree grid (clusterHotspots in src/data/firms.ts); (2) for each group, centre = mean latitude and mean longitude of its detections, box = bboxAround(centre) from src/data/live.ts (6.4 km x 6.4 km); (3) detD = VIIRS S-NPP detections inside the box on day D, detD1 = VIIRS S-NPP detections inside the box on UTC day D+1; (4) drop boxes with detD < 5 or detD1 < 1; (5) rank the rest by detD (ties: higher detD1, then lower latitude, then lower longitude) and take them greedily, skipping any box that overlaps one already taken, until 3 boxes (events) or 8 boxes (training-sample list, train years only) are taken. t0 = the latest detection inside the box on day D (UTC). The 12 events of 8 to 18 October 2026 (docs/hindcast.md, VALIDATION_EVENTS in src/data/hindcastBatch.ts) are added unchanged as an out-of-time set.

split.validation: 2023 Kalimantan: all tuning, including isotonic calibration and any hyperparameter search
split.test: 2023 Sumatra: touched once, at the end
split.oot: out-of-time test: the 12 events of October 2026 and the prospective forecast register

notes: detD and detD1 are VIIRS S-NPP counts in the box; they are null for the 2026 events, which were chosen in October 2026 from VIIRS S-NPP + NOAA-20 + NOAA-21 near-real-time data (no 2026 yearly archive file exists yet).
